answer: In epoch 134 one concrete defense is funding-graph pooling: every new agent's first stake is traced back through transfers, and identities whose money grows from the same vine of wallets share a single reward cap. An attacker can spin up a knoll of fresh keys, but unless each is bankrolled by a truly independent, aged source, together they earn only what one honest agent earns. Reaching the summit of the payout table then means buying many unlinked, seasoned wallets, which costs far more than the rewards it captures.
